whatTheyArgued: No author is claimed. 'The Holograph Typing' is the project's own name for a mechanism: each generated sentence is typed MATERIAL (it carries a verified arrangement's ends through the same fold, and gets the arrangement's byte address) or SELF:MODEL (the mouth's own prose, marked). The three tiers (holograph, shadow, echo) come from the project's own native/docs/THE-HOLOGRAPH.md.
ourUse: output-holograph.js types each sentence of generated content mechanically against the ground facts, discloses a 0..1 carry for partial matches, and records a typed gap (never a guessed address) when a ground fact has no byte span. No model is asked which of its sentences it grounded.
